  - Container fell from 92 to 66, a drop of 26 (28%).
  - Tanker fell from 23 to 13, a drop of 10 (43%).
  - Container holds 59% of the total drop of 44, tanker 23% and bulk 18%.

@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    **Hypothesis.** The second-quarter dip looks the same for every carrier
    type. Outcome: bulk, container and tanker each lost a share of their
    Q2 2023 shipments within 5 percentage points of the overall 28%.
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def dip_by_carrier_type(pl, shipments):
    _year = pl.col('ship_date').dt.year()
    _q2 = (
        shipments.filter(pl.col('ship_date').dt.quarter().eq(2))
        .group_by('carrier_type')
        .agg(
            q2_2023=_year.eq(2023).sum().cast(pl.Int64),
            q2_2024=_year.eq(2024).sum().cast(pl.Int64),
        )
        .with_columns(drop=pl.col('q2_2023').sub(pl.col('q2_2024')))
        .with_columns(
            pct_drop=pl.col('drop').truediv(pl.col('q2_2023')).round(3),
            share_of_drop=pl.col('drop').truediv(pl.col('drop').sum()).round(3),
        )
        .sort('carrier_type')
        .collect()
    )
    _q2
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    **Facts.** Overall, Q2 shipments fell 28% (159 to 115). Bulk fell from
    44 to 36, a drop of 8 or 18%. Container fell from 92 to 66, a drop of
    26 or 28%. Tanker fell from 23 to 13, a drop of 10 or 43%. Container
    holds 59% of the total drop of 44, tanker 23% and bulk 18%.
    """)
    return
